
---
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    theme: flatly
    highlight: tango
    df_print: kable
params:
  cart_path:    ""
  username:     "User"
  report_title: "VulSen Analytics Report"
  logo_path:    "www/logo.png"
---

<!--
  NOTE ON THIS REVISION:
  The previous version put `title:` / `author:` / `date:` in the YAML
  front matter above. Pandoc's default html_document template always
  renders those into a <div id="header"> block at the very top of the
  page -- ABOVE anything in the body -- no matter where the logo chunk
  sat in the .Rmd source. That's why the logo used to appear to "float"
  below the title instead of leading the page.

  Fix: title/author/date were removed from the YAML metadata (so Pandoc
  has nothing to auto-render), and the title block is now built by hand
  in the first chunk below, in the exact order we want: logo, then
  title, then byline/date. The browser tab title (<title> element) is
  still set correctly -- rmd_generator.R now passes it in separately via
  pandoc_args (`--metadata=pagetitle:...`), since that only affects the
  <head>, not the visible page.

  NOTE ON THIS REVISION (TOC redesign):
  toc_float is off in rmd_generator.R (see FIX 2 note there), so Pandoc
  bakes a fully-populated, JS-free `<div id="TOC"><ul>...</ul></div>`
  straight into the page -- but out of the box that's just a plain
  bulleted list sitting at the very top, above the masthead, with no
  sidebar styling at all. The CSS below turns that same static markup
  into a real left-hand sidebar card (title, rounded box, hover state,
  sticky-to-viewport via position:fixed) purely with CSS -- no jQuery,
  no scrollspy, nothing that breaks in a sanitized viewer. `.main-container`
  gets matching left padding so the body content clears the sidebar
  instead of running underneath it, and a mobile breakpoint drops the
  TOC back into normal document flow on narrow screens.
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo       = FALSE,
  warning    = FALSE,
  message    = FALSE,
  fig.align  = "center"
)

## Each cart item now renders via an explicit ggsave() call at its own
## stored width/height/dpi (see the "sections" chunk below) rather than
## relying on this chunk's fig.width/fig.height, so those two options were
## removed above -- they no longer do anything for the per-item figures.

library(ggplot2)

`%||%` <- function(a, b) {
  if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0 || (is.character(a) && !nzchar(a))) b else a
}

cart_items <- readRDS(params$cart_path)
```

```{css, echo=FALSE}
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Source+Serif+Pro:wght@600;700&display=swap');

:root {
  --vulsen-navy:      #0F1B3D;
  --vulsen-navy-soft: #1B2A54;
  --vulsen-accent:    #00C9A7;
  --vulsen-mute:      #7A8296;
  --vulsen-rule:      #E1E5EE;
  --vulsen-card-bg:   #FFFFFF;
  --vulsen-page-bg:   #F7F8FB;
}

body {
  color: #1A1A2E;
  font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  background-color: var(--vulsen-page-bg);
}

/* ---- Hand-built masthead (logo -> title -> byline), see .vulsen-masthead
   chunk below -- replaces Pandoc's auto title block entirely. ---- */
.vulsen-masthead {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 8px 0 22px 0;
}

.vulsen-logo {
  display: block;
  margin: 0 auto 16px auto;
  max-height: 84px;
  width: auto;
  /* natural shape -- no border-radius / circular mask */
}

.vulsen-masthead h1 {
  font-family: 'Source Serif Pro', Georgia, serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 2.1em;
  color: var(--vulsen-navy);
  border-bottom: none;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  padding-bottom: 0;
}

.vulsen-masthead .vulsen-byline {
  color: var(--vulsen-mute);
  font-size: 0.95em;
  font-style: italic;
}

.vulsen-masthead .vulsen-divider {
  width: 64px;
  height: 3px;
  background: var(--vulsen-accent);
  border-radius: 2px;
  margin: 14px auto 0 auto;
}

.vulsen-item-count {
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--vulsen-mute);
  font-size: 0.92em;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
}

/* ---- Headings for each cart section ---- */
h1, h2 {
  font-family: 'Source Serif Pro', Georgia, serif;
  color: var(--vulsen-navy);
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--vulsen-accent);
  padding-bottom: 6px;
  scroll-margin-top: 20px; /* keep anchored headings clear of any sticky chrome */
}

/* ---- Each section's figure sits in a soft card, like a printed exhibit ---- */
.vulsen-figure-card {
  background: var(--vulsen-card-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--vulsen-rule);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 14px 14px 4px 14px;
  margin: 14px 0 6px 0;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15, 27, 61, 0.06);
  break-inside: avoid;
}

.vulsen-caption {
  text-align: center;
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--vulsen-mute);
  font-size: 0.9em;
  margin-top: 4px;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
}

.vulsen-commentary {
  border-left: 3px solid var(--vulsen-accent);
  padding: 12px 18px;
  margin: 10px 0 26px 0;
  background: #F2FBF9;
  border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
  font-style: italic;
  color: #1A1A2E;
  break-inside: avoid;
}

.vulsen-item-meta {
  color: var(--vulsen-mute);
  font-size: 0.85em;
  font-style: italic;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.vulsen-footer {
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--vulsen-mute);
  font-size: 0.8em;
  font-style: italic;
  margin-top: 40px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--vulsen-rule);
  padding-top: 10px;
}

/* ---- Left-hand TOC sidebar (static markup, styled entirely with CSS) ----
   toc_float is FALSE in rmd_generator.R, so Pandoc writes a plain,
   fully-populated <div id="TOC"><ul>...</ul></div> at compile time --
   real anchor links, no client-side JS required (see the FIX 2 note at
   the top of this file). Out of the box that renders as an unstyled
   bulleted list sitting above the masthead, which is the "very basic
   flat" look. The rules below turn that same markup into a proper
   sidebar: a rounded card, pinned to the viewport while scrolling,
   with a "Contents" label, nested indentation for sub-items, and a
   hover/focus highlight so a clicked link stays visibly selected. */
.main-container {
  padding-left: 300px;
}

#TOC {
  position: fixed;
  top: 32px;
  left: 32px;
  width: 230px;
  max-height: calc(100vh - 64px);
  overflow-y: auto;
  background: var(--vulsen-card-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--vulsen-rule);
  border-radius: 10px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(15, 27, 61, 0.08);
  padding: 18px 16px;
  font-size: 0.86em;
}

/* "Contents" label, added purely in CSS -- no extra markup needed */
#TOC::before {
  content: "Contents";
  display: block;
  font-family: 'Source Serif Pro', Georgia, serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 1.05em;
  color: var(--vulsen-navy);
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  padding-bottom: 8px;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--vulsen-accent);
}

#TOC ul {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

#TOC ul ul {
  margin-left: 14px;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--vulsen-rule);
  padding-left: 10px;
}

#TOC li {
  margin: 2px 0;
}

#TOC a {
  display: block;
  color: var(--vulsen-navy-soft);
  text-decoration: none;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  line-height: 1.3;
  transition: background-color .15s ease, color .15s ease;
}

#TOC a:hover {
  background: var(--vulsen-page-bg);
  color: var(--vulsen-accent);
}

#TOC a:active,
#TOC a:focus {
  background: #E9F9F5;
  color: var(--vulsen-navy);
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* Narrow viewports: a fixed 230px sidebar plus 300px of body padding
   doesn't leave room for the report itself, so drop the TOC back into
   normal document flow above the masthead instead of overlapping it. */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .main-container { padding-left: 15px; }
  #TOC {
    position: static;
    width: auto;
    max-height: none;
    margin: 0 0 24px 0;
  }
}

/* ---- Print: avoid splitting a figure/commentary across a page break ---- */
@media print {
  .vulsen-figure-card, .vulsen-commentary { break-inside: avoid; }
  #TOC { display: none; }
  .main-container { padding-left: 0; }
}
```

```{r masthead, results='asis'}
logo_html <- ""
if (!is.null(params$logo_path) && nzchar(params$logo_path) && file.exists(params$logo_path)) {
  uri <- knitr::image_uri(params$logo_path)
  logo_html <- sprintf('<img src="%s" class="vulsen-logo" alt="logo">', uri)
}

cat(sprintf('
<div class="vulsen-masthead">
%s
<h1>%s</h1>
<div class="vulsen-byline">Prepared for %s &middot; %s</div>
<div class="vulsen-divider"></div>
</div>
',
  logo_html,
  params$report_title,
  params$username,
  format(Sys.Date(), "%B %d, %Y")
))
```

```{r sections, results='asis'}
for (i in seq_along(cart_items)) {

  item  <- cart_items[[i]]
  label <- item$module %||% "Item"
  ts    <- tryCatch(format(item$timestamp, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), error = function(e) "")

  cat(sprintf("\n## %02d. %s\n\n", i, label))

  if (nzchar(ts)) {
    cat(sprintf('<div class="vulsen-item-meta">Logged %s</div>\n\n', ts))
  }

  if (!is.null(item$plot)) {
    cat('<div class="vulsen-figure-card">\n\n')

    ## Render at the exact width/height/dpi captured when this item was
    ## added to the cart (see the "Capture dimensions for cart rendering"
    ## block in server/secmod_server.R and its counterpart in
    ## server/vulnerability_server.R), instead of relying on print(plot)
    ## and this chunk's fixed fig.width/fig.height default above. ggplot
    ## sizes text, legends, and margins relative to the physical save
    ## dimensions, so a global fixed size would silently distort every
    ## theme customization made on the preview. The PNG is embedded as a
    ## plain <img> with max-width:100%; height:auto, so the browser scales
    ## it responsively to fit the card without ever changing its true
    ## aspect ratio.
    item_w   <- item$width  %||% 8.5
    item_h   <- item$height %||% 4.9
    item_dpi <- item$dpi    %||% 150
    ## Honor the transparency choice captured when this plot was themed
    ## (attr(p, "vulsen_bg") set in apply_plot_overrides()) instead of
    ## always forcing a white background.
    item_bg  <- attr(item$plot, "vulsen_bg") %||% item$bg %||% "white"

    plot_png <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
    ggplot2::ggsave(plot_png, plot = item$plot,
                     width = item_w, height = item_h, dpi = item_dpi, bg = item_bg)
    plot_uri <- knitr::image_uri(plot_png)

    cat(sprintf(
      '<img src="%s" alt="Figure %d" style="max-width:100%%;height:auto;display:block;margin:0 auto;">\n\n',
      plot_uri, i
    ))

    cat(sprintf('\n<div class="vulsen-caption">Figure %d. %s</div>\n\n', i, label))
    cat('</div>\n\n')
  }

  if (!is.null(item$commentary) && nzchar(item$commentary)) {
    lines <- strsplit(item$commentary, "\n")[[1]]
    lines <- lines[nzchar(trimws(lines))]
    body  <- paste(vapply(lines, trimws, character(1)), collapse = "<br>")
    cat(sprintf('<div class="vulsen-commentary"><strong>Commentary.</strong> %s</div>\n\n', body))
  }
}
```
